description.value: The Skeena Bar is a bar located on Greig Avenue in the North Coast region of British Columbia. Situated along the Skeena River corridor, it serves a community that touring cyclists travelling Highway 16 (the Yellowhead Route) would pass through. As a local bar in a remote northern BC community, it may offer a welcome stop for cyclists looking for refreshment after long stretches of riding.
